components.Animations.AnimatedContent: 一个包装器，在滚动或挂载时对子元素进行动画，支持可配置的方向、距离、时长、缓动和消失选项。
components.Animations.BlobCursor: 有机的墨团光标，带有惯性和弹性变形效果，平滑跟随鼠标指针。
components.Animations.ClickSpark: 在点击位置创建粒子迸发效果。
components.Animations.Crosshair: 自定义十字准星光标，带有追踪和链接悬停效果。
components.Animations.Cubes: 3D 旋转立方体集群，支持自动旋转或悬停交互。
components.Animations.ElectricBorder: 抖动的高能电光边框，带有动画弧光、发光和可调节强度。
components.Animations.FadeContent: 简单的方向性淡入/滑入/滑出包装器，基于阈值激活。
components.Animations.GlareHover: 在悬停时为任意元素添加逼真的移动眩光高亮。
components.Animations.GradualBlur: 基于滚动或触发器逐步消除模糊，营造电影般的揭示效果。
components.Animations.GhostCursor: 半透明的幽灵光标，平滑跟随真实光标并带有拖尾效果。
components.Animations.ImageTrail: 基于光标的图片拖尾效果，内置多种变体。
components.Animations.LogoLoop: 品牌或技术标志的连续循环跑马灯，无缝重复并支持悬停暂停。
components.Animations.Magnet: 元素以磁性方式向光标靠近，然后以弹簧物理效果回到原位。
components.Animations.MetaBalls: 液态的元球墨团，融合与分离，带有平滑的隐式表面动画。
components.Animations.Strands: 发光的丝带状线条，在透明画布上波动交织。
components.Animations.MetallicPaint: 液态金属漆着色器，可应用于 SVG 元素。
components.Animations.Noise: 动画胶片颗粒/噪点叠加，为画面增添细腻质感和动感。
components.Animations.PixelTrail: 像素化的光标拖尾，发射渐隐的方块，带有复古数字感。
components.Animations.PixelTransition: 悬停时以像素溶解过渡揭示内容。
components.Animations.Ribbons: 流动的响应式丝带/光标拖尾，由物理和鼠标运动驱动。
components.Animations.ShapeBlur: 变形的模糊几何形状，悬停时触发效果。
components.Animations.SplashCursor: 光标处的液体飞溅迸发，带有卷曲涟漪和波浪。
components.Animations.StarBorder: 星星/火花边框沿内容轨道运行，带有闪烁脉冲。
components.Animations.StickerPeel: 贴纸角部抬起 + 剥离交互，使用 3D 变换和阴影深度。
components.Animations.TargetCursor: 光标跟随动画，4 个角锁定目标。
components.Animations.LaserFlow: 动态激光照射在表面上流动，效果可定制。
components.Animations.Antigravity: 3D 反重力粒子场，以平滑运动从光标处排斥。
components.Animations.OrbitImages: 基于 SVG 路径的可定制轨道旋转图片效果。
components.Animations.MagicRings: 交互式魔法环效果，参数可定制。
components.TextAnimations.AsciiText: 以动画 ASCII 背景渲染文本，营造复古感。
components.TextAnimations.BlurText: 文本从模糊开始，然后清晰呈现的柔焦揭示效果。
components.TextAnimations.CircularText: 将字符排列在圆形周围，可选择旋转动画。
components.TextAnimations.CountUp: 动画数字计数器，支持格式化和小数。
components.TextAnimations.CurvedLoop: 沿可定制曲线的流动循环文本路径，支持拖拽交互。
components.TextAnimations.DecryptedText: 黑客风格的解密效果，随机循环字形直到最终显示真实文本。
components.TextAnimations.FallingText: 字符受重力和弹跳影响下落，营造有趣的入场效果。
components.TextAnimations.FuzzyText: 振动的模糊文本，悬停强度可控。
components.TextAnimations.GlitchText: RGB 分离和扭曲的故障效果，带有抖动。
components.TextAnimations.GradientText: 在文本上动画渐变色扫描，速度和颜色可控。
components.TextAnimations.RotatingText: 在多个短语间循环切换，带 3D 旋转/翻转过渡。
components.TextAnimations.ScrambleText: 检测光标位置并应用文本扭曲效果。
components.TextAnimations.ScrollFloat: 文本随滚动轻轻浮动/视差偏移。
components.TextAnimations.ScrollReveal: 文本随滚动逐渐消除模糊并显现。
components.TextAnimations.ScrollVelocity: 文字跑马灯动画，速度和扭曲度随用户滚动速度变化。
components.TextAnimations.SplitText: 将文本拆分为字符/单词，实现交错入场动画。
components.TextAnimations.TextCursor: 让任意文本元素跟随光标，在身后留下一串副本。
components.TextAnimations.TextPressure: 字符根据指针压力区域交互式缩放/扭曲。
components.TextAnimations.TextType: 打字机效果，带闪烁光标和可调节的键入节奏。
components.TextAnimations.TrueFocus: 按顺序对一系列单词应用动态模糊/清晰效果。
components.TextAnimations.VariableProximity: 字母样式随指针距离连续变化。
components.TextAnimations.Shuffle: 动画文本揭示效果，字符在落定前随机打乱。
components.Components.AnimatedList: 列表项以交错的动效入场，呈现精致的揭示效果。
components.Components.BounceCards: 卡片在挂载时弹跳入场。
components.Components.BubbleMenu: 浮动圆形扩展菜单，子项交错揭示。
components.Components.CardNav: 可展开的导航栏，卡片面板揭示嵌套链接。
components.Components.CardSwap: 卡片动画交换位置，布局过渡平滑。
components.Components.Carousel: 响应式轮播，支持触摸手势、循环和过渡动画。
components.Components.ChromaGrid: 响应式灰度网格，悬停时显示颜色。
components.Components.Counter: 灵活的动画计数器，支持增量和缓动。
components.Components.DecayCard: 悬停视差效果，卡片内容逐渐消散。
components.Components.Dock: macOS 风格放大 dock，图标根据距离缩放。
components.Components.DomeGallery: 沉浸式 3D 球幕图片库，在半球面上投影图片。
components.Components.ElasticSlider: 滑块手柄弹性拉伸，然后以弹簧物理回弹。
components.Components.FlowingMenu: 液态流动的激活指示器在菜单项间滑动。
components.Components.Folder: 交互式文件夹，打开时以平滑动效展示嵌套内容。
components.Components.GlassIcons: 毛玻璃模糊风格的图标集。
components.Components.GlassSurface: 高级 Apple 风格玻璃表面，实时扭曲 + 光照。
components.Components.GooeyNav: 导航指示器在项之间以粘性墨团过渡变形。
components.Components.InfiniteMenu: 水平循环菜单，无限滚动且无缝衔接。
components.Components.MagicBento: 交互式 Bento 网格，磁贴可扩展 + 动画，多种选项。
components.Components.Masonry: 响应式瀑布流布局，动画重排 + 间距优化。
components.Components.PillNav: 极简胶囊导航，滑动高亮 + 平滑缓动。
components.Components.PixelCard: 卡片内容通过像素扩展过渡揭示。
components.Components.ProfileCard: 动画个人资料卡片眩光，带 3D 悬停效果。
components.Components.ReflectiveCard: 金属卡片，带实时摄像头反射和 SVG 置换滤镜。
components.Components.ScrollStack: 重叠卡片堆随滚动逐层揭示，带有深度层次。
components.Components.SpotlightCard: 动态聚光灯跟随光标，投射渐变光照。
components.Components.BorderGlow: 发光网格渐变边框，跟随光标方向并在边缘处增强。
components.Components.Stack: 分层卡片堆，支持滑动动画、自动播放和平滑过渡。
components.Components.Stepper: 动画多步进度指示器，带激活状态过渡。
components.Components.TiltedCard: 响应指针的 3D 视角倾斜卡片。
components.Components.StaggeredMenu: 菜单项交错动画，开/关平滑过渡。
components.Components.ModelViewer: 交互式 3D 模型查看器，支持轨道缩放、视差、悬停旋转和光照预设。
components.Backgrounds.Balatro: Balatro 着色器，完全可定制且可交互。
components.Backgrounds.Ballpit: 物理球池模拟，弹跳的多彩球体。
components.Backgrounds.Beams: 交叉的动画飘带，属性可定制。
components.Backgrounds.ColorBends: 鲜艳的色彩弯曲，带有平滑流动动画。
components.Backgrounds.DarkVeil: 微妙的暗色背景，带有平滑动画和后处理效果。
components.Backgrounds.Dither: 复古抖动噪点着色器背景。
components.Backgrounds.DotField: 交互式点阵网格，带光标凸起、发光、闪烁和波浪效果。
components.Backgrounds.DotGrid: 动画点阵网格，支持光标交互。
components.Backgrounds.FaultyTerminal: 终端 CRT 扫描线方块效果，带闪烁 + 噪点。
components.Backgrounds.Galaxy: 视差写实星空，支持指针交互。
components.Backgrounds.GradientBlinds: 分层渐变色百叶窗，带聚光灯和噪点扭曲。
components.Backgrounds.Lightfall: 彩色光条纹坠入发光隧道，带光标光源。
components.Backgrounds.Ferrofluid: 搅动的磁性流体，由发光轮廓线描绘，带光标磁铁。
components.Backgrounds.Grainient: 颗粒状渐变漩涡，带有柔和波形扭曲。
components.Backgrounds.GridScan: 动画网格房间 3D 扫描效果和酷炫交互。
components.Backgrounds.GridDistortion: 变形的网格平滑响应光标扭曲。
components.Backgrounds.GridMotion: 基于光标位置的透视运动网格线。
components.Backgrounds.Hyperspeed: 持续运动的动画线条，模拟点击长按时的超空间旅行。
components.Backgrounds.Iridescence: 光滑的彩虹色着色器，带有变幻的波纹。
components.Backgrounds.LightRays: 体积光射线/光束，方向可定制。
components.Backgrounds.Lightning: 程序化闪电，带分支和发光闪烁。
components.Backgrounds.LineWaves: 动画线条波纹图案，带彩色扭曲变形。
components.Backgrounds.EvilEye: 程序化邪眼着色器，带动画虹膜、裂隙瞳孔和火光外发光。
components.Backgrounds.Radar: 雷达扫描效果，带同心圆环、径向辐条和旋转光束。
components.Backgrounds.SoftAurora: 柔和极光着色器，带 3D Perlin 噪声和余弦渐变调色板。
components.Backgrounds.LiquidChrome: 液态金属铬着色器，带流动反射表面。
components.Backgrounds.Orb: 浮动能量球，悬停效果可定制。
components.Backgrounds.PixelBlast: 爆炸像素粒子迸发，可选液体后处理效果。
components.Backgrounds.Plasma: 有机等离子渐变漩涡 + 变形，带有平滑湍流。
components.Backgrounds.PlasmaWave: 光线追踪等离子波，双波干涉和 OGL。
components.Backgrounds.Prism: 旋转棱镜，强度、大小和颜色可配置。
components.Backgrounds.PrismaticBurst: 光线迸发，颜色、扭曲、数量可控。
components.Backgrounds.RippleGrid: 连续动画的涟漪效果网格。
components.Backgrounds.Silk: 柔和光照的平滑波纹背景。
components.Backgrounds.SideRays: 从侧面发出的动画光线，颜色和速度可定制。
components.Backgrounds.ShapeGrid: 动画网格，支持形状变体（方形、六边形、圆形、三角形）+ 方向定制。
components.Backgrounds.Threads: 线条构成的织物状运动动画图案。
components.Backgrounds.Waves: 分层线条形成平滑波浪图案并带动画。
components.Backgrounds.LiquidEther: 交互式液体着色器，带流动扭曲和可定制颜色。
components.Backgrounds.FloatingLines: 响应光标移动的 3D 浮动线条。
components.Backgrounds.LightPillar: 带发光效果的垂直光柱。
components.Backgrounds.PixelSnow: 下落中的像素化雪花效果，密度和速度可定制。

propDescs.AnimatedContent.distance: 组件在动画过程中移动的距离（像素）。
propDescs.AnimatedContent.ease: 用于动画的 GSAP 缓动函数。
propDescs.AnimatedContent.initialOpacity: 动画开始前的初始不透明度。
propDescs.AnimatedContent.animateOpacity: 过渡期间是否对不透明度进行动画处理。
propDescs.AnimatedContent.delay: 动画开始前的延迟时间（秒）。
propDescs.Antigravity.waveAmplitude: 波的强度（0 表示完美圆形）。
propDescs.Antigravity.lerpSpeed: 粒子移动到环上的速度。
propDescs.BlobCursor.sizes: 每个墨团的大小（像素）。长度必须 ≥ trailCount。
propDescs.BlobCursor.innerSizes: 内部圆点的大小（像素）。长度必须 ≥ trailCount。
propDescs.BlobCursor.opacities: 每个墨团的不透明度。长度 ≥ trailCount。
propDescs.BlobCursor.filterId: 可选的自定义滤镜 ID（用于多实例场景）。
propDescs.BlobCursor.filterStdDeviation: SVG 滤镜中 feGaussianBlur 的 stdDeviation 值。
propDescs.BlobCursor.filterColorMatrixValues: SVG 滤镜中 feColorMatrix 的值。
propDescs.BlobCursor.useFilter: 是否启用 SVG 滤镜。
propDescs.BlobCursor.fastDuration: 引领墨团的 GSAP 动画时长。
propDescs.BlobCursor.slowDuration: 跟随墨团的 GSAP 动画时长。
propDescs.BlobCursor.fastEase: 引领墨团的 GSAP 缓动函数。
propDescs.BlobCursor.slowEase: 跟随墨团的 GSAP 缓动函数。
propDescs.BlobCursor.zIndex: 整个组件的 CSS z-index 值。
propDescs.ClickSpark.sparkRadius: 火花从点击中心扩散的距离。
propDescs.ClickSpark.sparkCount: 每次点击产生的火花线条数量。
propDescs.ClickSpark.extraScale: 火花距离和大小的缩放倍数。
propDescs.Crosshair.containerRef: 可选的容器引用，用于将十字准星限制在特定元素内。
propDescs.Cubes.gridSize: 网格的大小（每行/列的立方体数量）。
propDescs.Cubes.cubeSize: 每个立方体的固定大小（像素）。
propDescs.Cubes.maxAngle: 倾斜效果的最大旋转角度（度）。
propDescs.Cubes.radius: 倾斜效果的半径（光标周围受影响的立方体数量）。
propDescs.Cubes.easing: 倾斜动画的 GSAP 缓动函数。
propDescs.Cubes.duration: 进入和离开效果的动画时长。
propDescs.Cubes.cellGap: 立方体之间的间距。可以是数值，也可以是包含 row/col 属性的对象。
propDescs.Cubes.borderStyle: 立方体面的 CSS 边框样式。
propDescs.Cubes.shadow: 立方体的阴影效果。可以是布尔值或自定义 CSS 阴影。
propDescs.Cubes.autoAnimate: 用户闲置时是否自动播放动画。
propDescs.Cubes.rippleOnClick: 点击时是否显示涟漪效果。
propDescs.ElectricBorder.color: 描边/发光颜色。支持任何 CSS 颜色值（hex、rgb、hsl）。
propDescs.ElectricBorder.speed: 动画速度倍率（值越大速度越快）。
propDescs.ElectricBorder.chaos: 扭曲强度（0 = 无扭曲，值越大越混乱）。
propDescs.ElectricBorder.borderRadius: 电光边框路径的圆角半径（像素）。
propDescs.ElectricBorder.className: 应用于根容器的可选 className。
propDescs.ElectricBorder.children: 在带边框的容器内渲染的内容。
propDescs.FadeContent.blur: 是否在进入时同时应用 10px 模糊动画。
propDescs.FadeContent.duration: 动画时长；大于 10 的值视为毫秒，否则为秒。
propDescs.FadeContent.delay: 动画开始前的延迟；大于 10 的值视为毫秒。
propDescs.FadeContent.disappearAfter: 若大于 0，进入动画完成后经过此时长后淡出。
propDescs.FadeContent.disappearEase: 淡出动画的 GSAP 缓动函数。
propDescs.FadeContent.onDisappearanceComplete: 可选的淡出动画完成时触发。
propDescs.FadeContent.container: 可选的滚动容器（选择器或元素），用于 ScrollTrigger。
propDescs.FadeContent.class: 容器的额外 CSS 类名。
propDescs.GhostCursor.className: 容器的额外 CSS 类名。
propDescs.GhostCursor.trailLength: 光标轨迹存储的点数（越长则拖影越长）。
propDescs.GhostCursor.inertia: 指针停止后的速度保持度。值越大，光标滑动时间越长。
propDescs.GhostCursor.grainIntensity: 胶片颗粒后处理效果的强度。
propDescs.GhostCursor.bloomRadius: 控制发光扩散范围的 UnrealBloom 半径。
propDescs.GhostCursor.bloomThreshold: UnrealBloom 阈值；值越低，参与发光效果的像素越多。
propDescs.GhostCursor.brightness: 应用于效果颜色的最终亮度倍率。
propDescs.GhostCursor.color: 幽灵光标效果的基础颜色。
propDescs.GhostCursor.mixBlendMode: 与页面内容合成时使用的混合模式。
propDescs.GhostCursor.edgeIntensity: 画布边缘的变暗程度。0 = 无效果，1 = 最强。
propDescs.GhostCursor.maxDevicePixelRatio: Upper cap for devicePixelRatio to control render cost on high-DPR displays.
propDescs.GhostCursor.targetPixels: Pixel budget. Resolution is dynamically scaled to keep total pixel count under this budget.
propDescs.GhostCursor.fadeDelayMs: Idle delay before the trail starts to fade after pointer leaves/stops.
propDescs.GhostCursor.fadeDurationMs: Duration of the trail fade-out once the delay has elapsed.
propDescs.GhostCursor.zIndex: z-index applied to the canvas for layering above/below content.
propDescs.GlareHover.glareColor: 眩光效果的颜色（hex 格式）。
propDescs.GlareHover.glareSize: 眩光效果的大小百分比。
propDescs.GradualBlur.position: 模糊叠加层附加的边缘位置。
propDescs.GradualBlur.strength: 基础模糊强度倍率（影响每一层）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.height: 叠加层高度（用于顶部/底部位置）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.divCount: 堆叠的模糊层数（越多则渐变越平滑）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.exponential: 使用指数级进增强末端模糊效果。
propDescs.GradualBlur.curve: 应用于层进级的分布曲线。
propDescs.GradualBlur.opacity: 应用于每个模糊层的不透明度。
propDescs.GradualBlur.animated: 淡入显示（true）或滚动时渐显（scroll）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.easing: 动画缓动函数（不透明度/backdrop-filter）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.hoverIntensity: 悬停时应用于强度的倍率。
propDescs.GradualBlur.target: 相对于父容器或整个页面的定位方式（fixed）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.zIndex: 基础 z-index（页面目标会额外加 100）。
propDescs.GradualBlur.onAnimationComplete: Callback fired after animated reveal completes.
propDescs.GradualBlur.className: 附加到根元素的额外类名。
propDescs.GradualBlur.style: 合并到容器样式的内联样式覆盖。
propDescs.ImageTrail.items: 一组图片 URL，将在轨迹中进行动画展示。
propDescs.ImageTrail.variant: 数字 1 到 8，对应不同的动画样式。
propDescs.LaserFlow.horizontalBeamOffset: 光束的水平偏移量（画布宽度的 0-1 比例）。
propDescs.LaserFlow.verticalBeamOffset: 光束的垂直偏移量（画布高度的 0-1 比例）。
propDescs.LaserFlow.horizontalSizing: 光束足迹的水平缩放因子。
propDescs.LaserFlow.verticalSizing: 光束足迹的垂直缩放因子。
propDescs.LaserFlow.fogScale: 雾效噪声的空间缩放比例。
propDescs.LaserFlow.mouseTiltStrength: 鼠标水平移动对雾体积的倾斜影响程度。
propDescs.LaserFlow.decay: 光束衰减形状，用于采样包络。
propDescs.LaserFlow.falloffStart: 逆平方混合中使用的衰减起始半径。
propDescs.LaserFlow.dpr: 设备像素比覆盖值（默认为 window.devicePixelRatio）。
propDescs.LogoLoop.hoverSpeed: 悬停组件时的速度。设为 0 暂停。
propDescs.LogoLoop.fadeOut: 是否在容器边缘应用淡出效果。
propDescs.LogoLoop.renderItem: Custom render function for each logo item. Allows full control over item rendering for animations, tooltips, etc.
propDescs.LogoLoop.ariaLabel: Accessibility label for the logo loop component.
propDescs.LogoLoop.className: 应用于根元素的额外 CSS 类名。
propDescs.LogoLoop.style: 应用于根元素的内联样式。
propDescs.MagicRings.colorTwo: 第二种颜色——圆环从 color 向 colorTwo 插值渐变。
propDescs.MagicRings.attenuation: 发光衰减度——值越高，发光范围越紧凑。
propDescs.MagicRings.baseRadius: 最内层圆环的半径（归一化值）。
propDescs.MagicRings.scaleRate: 圆环随时间扩展的速度。
propDescs.MagicRings.blur: CSS 模糊值（像素）——产生绽放/发光效果。
propDescs.MagicRings.rotation: 图案的静态旋转角度（度）。
propDescs.MagicRings.ringGap: Exponential base for angular cutaway per ring.
propDescs.MagicRings.fadeIn: 周期内圆环淡入的时长。
propDescs.MagicRings.fadeOut: 周期内圆环淡出的开始时间。
propDescs.MagicRings.followMouse: 圆环是否跟随鼠标光标移动。
propDescs.MagicRings.mouseInfluence: 鼠标跟随强度（followMouse 为 true 时生效）。
propDescs.MagicRings.parallax: 基于鼠标位置的每环深度偏移。
propDescs.MagicRings.clickBurst: 点击时触发亮度闪烁和缩放脉冲。
propDescs.Magnet.padding: 指定元素周围触发磁吸效果的距离（像素）。
propDescs.Magnet.disabled: 设为 true 时禁用磁吸效果。
propDescs.Magnet.magnetStrength: 控制磁吸强度；值越大移动越小，值越小移动越大。
propDescs.Magnet.activeTransition: 磁吸效果激活时应用于元素的 CSS 过渡属性。
propDescs.Magnet.inactiveTransition: 磁吸效果未激活（鼠标移出范围）时应用的 CSS 过渡属性。
propDescs.Magnet.wrapperClassName: 最外层包裹元素的可选 CSS 类名。
propDescs.Magnet.innerClassName: 移动元素（内部元素）的可选 CSS 类名。
propDescs.MagnetLines.containerSize: 整个网格容器的宽度和高度。
propDescs.MagnetLines.lineWidth: 指针移动前的初始旋转角度（度）。
propDescs.MagnetLines.className: 应用于容器的额外类名。
propDescs.MetaBalls.enableMouseInteraction: 启用或禁用球体跟随鼠标移动。
propDescs.MetaBalls.enableTransparency: 启用或禁用动画容器的透明背景。
propDescs.MetaBalls.hoverSmoothness: 光标球跟随鼠标时的平滑因子。
propDescs.MetaBalls.clumpFactor: 确定球体之间渲染的紧密程度。
propDescs.MetallicPaint.imageSrc: 用于金属漆效果的图片 URL 或路径。
propDescs.MetallicPaint.refraction: Amount of chromatic aberration (color separation). Creates the rainbow edge effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.blur: Blur amount for the pattern transitions. Higher values create softer gradients.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.liquid: Amount of liquid/wavy animation applied to the pattern.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.speed: Animation speed multiplier. Set to 0 to disable animation.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.brightness: Overall brightness of the metallic effect. Values above 1 increase brightness.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.contrast: 最终图像的对比度调整。
propDescs.MetallicPaint.angle: Rotation angle of the pattern in degrees.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.fresnel: Fresnel effect intensity. Controls edge highlighting based on viewing angle.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.lightColor: Hex color for the bright/highlight areas of the metallic effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.darkColor: Hex color for the dark/shadow areas of the metallic effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.patternSharpness: Controls the sharpness of metallic band transitions. Higher = sharper edges.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.waveAmplitude: Intensity of the wave distortion effect.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.noiseScale: Scale of the noise pattern. Higher = more detailed noise.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.chromaticSpread: Multiplier for chromatic aberration spread between RGB channels.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.mouseAnimation: When true, mouse position controls wave animation instead of auto-loop.
propDescs.MetallicPaint.distortion: Amount of noise-based distortion applied to the pattern flow (0-1).
propDescs.MetallicPaint.contour: Intensity of edge contour effect that warps the pattern along shape boundaries (0-1).
propDescs.MetallicPaint.tintColor: Hex color for color burn tint effect. White = no tint.
propDescs.Noise.patternScaleX: 图案在 X 方向上的缩放。值为 1 表示原始大小。
propDescs.Noise.patternScaleY: 图案在 Y 方向上的缩放。值为 1 表示原始大小。
propDescs.Noise.patternRefreshInterval: 每次重新生成图案的间隔时间（毫秒）。
propDescs.OrbitImages.images: 在轨道上显示的图片 URL 数组。
propDescs.OrbitImages.shape: Preset shape: ellipse, circle, square, rectangle, triangle, star, heart, infinity, wave, or custom.
propDescs.OrbitImages.customPath: Custom SVG path string (used when shape="custom").
propDescs.OrbitImages.baseWidth: Base width for the design coordinate space used for responsive scaling.
propDescs.OrbitImages.radius: Radius for circle, square, triangle, star, heart shapes.
propDescs.OrbitImages.starPoints: Number of points for star shape.
propDescs.OrbitImages.rotation: Rotation angle of the entire orbit path in degrees.
propDescs.OrbitImages.duration: Duration of one complete orbit in seconds.
propDescs.OrbitImages.itemSize: Width/height of each orbiting item in pixels.
propDescs.OrbitImages.fill: Whether to distribute items evenly around the orbit.
propDescs.OrbitImages.className: 容器元素的额外 CSS 类名。
propDescs.OrbitImages.showPath: Whether to show the orbit path for debugging.
propDescs.OrbitImages.pathColor: Stroke color when showPath is true.
propDescs.OrbitImages.pathWidth: Stroke width when showPath is true.
propDescs.OrbitImages.easing: Animation easing: linear, easeIn, easeOut, easeInOut.
propDescs.OrbitImages.centerContent: Custom content rendered at the center of the orbit.
propDescs.OrbitImages.responsive: Enable responsive scaling based on container width.
propDescs.PixelTransition.firstContent: Content to show by default (e.g., an or text).
propDescs.PixelTransition.secondContent: Content revealed upon hover or click.
propDescs.PixelTransition.gridSize: Number of rows/columns in the pixel grid.
propDescs.PixelTransition.pixelColor: Background color used for each pixel block.
propDescs.PixelTransition.animationStepDuration: Length of the pixel reveal/hide in seconds.
propDescs.PixelTransition.aspectRatio: If true, the transition will not revert on mouse leave or subsequent clicks.
propDescs.PixelTransition.className: 容器元素的额外 CSS 类名。
propDescs.Ribbons.colors: An array of color strings to be used for the ribbons.
propDescs.Ribbons.baseSpring: Base spring factor for the physics controlling ribbon motion.
propDescs.Ribbons.baseFriction: Base friction factor that dampens the ribbon motion.
propDescs.Ribbons.baseThickness: The base thickness of the ribbons.
propDescs.Ribbons.offsetFactor: A factor to horizontally offset the starting positions of the ribbons.
propDescs.Ribbons.maxAge: Delay in milliseconds controlling how long the ribbon trails extend.
propDescs.Ribbons.pointCount: The number of points that make up each ribbon.
propDescs.Ribbons.speedMultiplier: Multiplier that adjusts how fast trailing points interpolate towards the head.
propDescs.Ribbons.enableFade: If true, a fade effect is applied along the length of the ribbon.
propDescs.Ribbons.enableShaderEffect: If true, an additional sine-wave shader effect is applied to the ribbons.
propDescs.Ribbons.effectAmplitude: The amplitude of the shader displacement effect.
propDescs.Ribbons.backgroundColor: An RGBA array specifying the clear color for the renderer.
propDescs.ShapeBlur.variation: Selects the shape variation (0-3) used by the shader.
propDescs.ShapeBlur.pixelRatioProp: Overrides the pixel ratio, typically set to the device pixel ratio.
propDescs.ShapeBlur.shapeSize: Controls the size of the shape.
propDescs.ShapeBlur.roundness: Sets the thickness of the border.
propDescs.ShapeBlur.circleSize: Determines the size of the hover circle effect.
propDescs.ShapeBlur.circleEdge: Controls the edge softness of the hover circle.
propDescs.SplashCursor.SIM_RESOLUTION: Fluid simulation resolution for velocity fields.
propDescs.SplashCursor.CAPTURE_RESOLUTION: Resolution used for certain capture operations (rarely changed).
propDescs.SplashCursor.DENSITY_DISSIPATION: Rate at which color/density dissipates over time.
propDescs.SplashCursor.VELOCITY_DISSIPATION: Rate at which velocity dissipates over time.
propDescs.SplashCursor.PRESSURE: Base pressure for the fluid simulation.
propDescs.SplashCursor.PRESSURE_ITERATIONS: Number of Jacobi iterations used for the pressure solver.
propDescs.SplashCursor.CURL: Amount of vorticity/curl to apply for swirling effects.
propDescs.SplashCursor.SPLAT_RADIUS: Toggles simple lighting/shading on the fluid.
propDescs.SplashCursor.COLOR_UPDATE_SPEED: Frequency at which pointer colors are re-randomized.
propDescs.SplashCursor.RAINBOW_MODE: When true, uses randomly cycling rainbow colors. When false, uses the COLOR prop.
propDescs.SplashCursor.COLOR: Hex color for the cursor effect when RAINBOW_MODE is false.
propDescs.SplashCursor.BACK_COLOR: Base background color for the fluid. Not always used if TRANSPARENT is true.
propDescs.StarBorder.as: Allows specifying the type of the parent component to be rendered.
propDescs.StarBorder.customClass: Allows adding custom classes to the component.
propDescs.StarBorder.speed: 星星沿路径移动的速度。
propDescs.StarBorder.thickness: Controls the thickness of the star border effect.
propDescs.StickerPeel.imageSrc: The source URL for the sticker image
propDescs.StickerPeel.rotate: The rotation angle in degrees when dragging
propDescs.StickerPeel.peelBackHoverPct: Percentage of peel effect on hover (0-100)
propDescs.StickerPeel.peelBackActivePct: Percentage of peel effect when active/clicked (0-100)
propDescs.StickerPeel.peelEasing: GSAP easing function for peel animations
propDescs.StickerPeel.peelHoverEasing: GSAP easing function for hover transitions
propDescs.StickerPeel.width: Width of the sticker in pixels
propDescs.StickerPeel.initialPosition: Custom class name for additional styling
propDescs.Strands.colors: Palette of hex colors cycled across the strands. Pass an empty array to use the built-in rainbow spectrum.
propDescs.Strands.count: Number of strands woven through the animation.
propDescs.Strands.waviness: Density of the curves along each strand.
propDescs.Strands.glow: Strength of the luminous bloom around the strands.
propDescs.Strands.taper: How sharply the strands fade out toward the edges.
propDescs.Strands.spread: Separation between strands so they fan out instead of overlapping.
propDescs.Strands.hueShift: Rotates the colors around the strands for variation.
propDescs.Strands.intensity: Overall brightness and energy of the effect.
propDescs.Strands.saturation: Vibrance of the colors. Above 1 makes them more intense, below 1 fades to grayscale.
propDescs.Strands.opacity: Overall transparency of the rendered strands.
propDescs.Strands.scale: Zooms the whole effect in or out to make the strands bigger or smaller.
propDescs.Strands.glass: Renders the strands inside a refractive glass ball.
propDescs.Strands.refraction: How strongly the glass ball bends the light passing through it.
propDescs.Strands.dispersion: Amount of rainbow color separation along the edges of the glass ball.
propDescs.Strands.glassSize: Size of the glass ball relative to the canvas.
propDescs.Strands.className: 容器的额外 CSS 类名。
propDescs.TargetCursor.targetSelector: CSS selector for elements that should trigger the cursor targeting effect
propDescs.TargetCursor.spinDuration: Whether to hide the default browser cursor when the component is active
propDescs.TargetCursor.hoverDuration: Duration in seconds for the transition when the cursor locks onto a target
propDescs.TargetCursor.parallaxOn: Enables a subtle parallax effect on the corners when moving over a target
propDescs.Aurora.colorStops: An array of three hex colors defining the aurora gradient.
propDescs.Aurora.speed: Controls the animation speed. Higher values make the aurora move faster.
propDescs.Aurora.blend: Controls the blending of the aurora effect with the background.
propDescs.Aurora.amplitude: Controls the height intensity of the aurora effect.
propDescs.Balatro.spinRotation: Base rotation amount affecting the shader effect.
propDescs.Balatro.spinAmount: Amount of spin influence based on UV length.
propDescs.Balatro.isRotate: Determines if the shader rotates continuously.
propDescs.Balatro.mouseInteraction: Enables or disables mouse interaction for rotation.
propDescs.Ballpit.count: Sets the number of balls in the ballpit.
propDescs.Ballpit.gravity: Controls the gravity affecting the balls.
propDescs.Ballpit.friction: Sets the friction applied to the ball movement.
propDescs.Ballpit.wallBounce: Determines how much balls bounce off walls.
propDescs.Ballpit.followCursor: Enables or disables the sphere following the cursor.
propDescs.Ballpit.colors: Defines the colors of the balls.
propDescs.Ballpit.ambientIntensity: Controls the intensity of ambient light.
propDescs.Ballpit.lightIntensity: Sets the intensity of the main light source.
propDescs.Ballpit.minSize: Specifies the minimum size of the balls.
propDescs.Ballpit.maxSize: Specifies the maximum size of the balls.
propDescs.Ballpit.size0: Initial size value for the cursor ball.
propDescs.Ballpit.maxVelocity: Limits the maximum velocity of the balls.
propDescs.Beams.noiseIntensity: Intensity of the noise effect overlay.
propDescs.Beams.rotation: Rotation of the entire beams system in degrees.
propDescs.ColorBends.speed: Animation time scale of the shader.
propDescs.ColorBends.colors: Palette of up to 8 hex colors used to blend the bends.
propDescs.ColorBends.transparent: Whether the background is transparent (uses alpha).
propDescs.ColorBends.frequency: Wave frequency used in the pattern.
propDescs.ColorBends.warpStrength: Amount of warping/distortion applied to waves.
propDescs.ColorBends.mouseInfluence: How strongly the waves react to pointer movement.
propDescs.ColorBends.parallax: Parallax factor shifting content with pointer.
propDescs.ColorBends.iterations: Number of extra warp passes (1-5). Higher values create more complex patterns.
propDescs.ColorBends.intensity: Brightness multiplier for the final color output.
propDescs.ColorBends.bandWidth: Controls the width/falloff of each color band.
propDescs.ColorBends.className: Additional CSS classes for the container.
propDescs.DarkVeil.hueShift: Shifts the hue of the entire animation.
propDescs.DarkVeil.warpAmount: Amount of warp distortion applied to the effect.
propDescs.Dither.waveSpeed: Controls the speed of the wave animation.
propDescs.Dither.waveFrequency: Sets the frequency of the wave pattern.
propDescs.Dither.waveAmplitude: Controls the amplitude of the wave pattern.
propDescs.Dither.waveColor: RGB color values for the wave pattern (0-1 range).
propDescs.Dither.colorNum: Number of colors in the dithering palette.
propDescs.Dither.pixelSize: Size of the dithering pixels for the retro effect.
propDescs.Dither.disableAnimation: Disables the wave animation when set to true.
propDescs.Dither.enableMouseInteraction: Enables mouse interaction with the wave pattern.
propDescs.Dither.mouseRadius: Radius of the mouse interaction effect.
propDescs.DotField.dotRadius: Radius of each individual dot in the grid.
propDescs.DotField.dotSpacing: Spacing between dots in the grid.
propDescs.DotField.cursorRadius: Radius of the cursor interaction area.
propDescs.DotField.cursorForce: Force applied to dots when not in bulge mode.
propDescs.DotField.bulgeOnly: When true, dots bulge around the cursor. When false, dots are pushed with physics.
propDescs.DotField.bulgeStrength: Strength of the bulge effect around the cursor.
propDescs.DotField.glowRadius: Radius of the SVG glow effect that follows the cursor.
propDescs.DotField.sparkle: When enabled, a small fraction of dots sparkle at a larger size.
propDescs.DotField.waveAmplitude: Amplitude of the wave displacement animation applied to dots.
propDescs.DotField.gradientFrom: Start color of the diagonal gradient applied to dots.
propDescs.DotField.gradientTo: End color of the diagonal gradient applied to dots.
propDescs.DotField.glowColor: Color of the radial glow effect that follows the cursor.
propDescs.DotField.class: Extra classes for the root wrapper.
propDescs.DotGrid.dotSize: Size of each dot in pixels.
propDescs.DotGrid.gap: Gap between each dot in pixels.
propDescs.DotGrid.activeColor: Color of dots when hovered or activated.
propDescs.DotGrid.proximity: Radius around the mouse pointer within which dots react.
propDescs.DotGrid.speedTrigger: Mouse speed threshold to trigger inertia effect.
propDescs.DotGrid.shockRadius: Radius of the shockwave effect on click.
propDescs.DotGrid.shockStrength: Strength of the shockwave effect on click.
propDescs.DotGrid.returnDuration: Duration for dots to return to their original position after inertia.
propDescs.DotGrid.className: Additional CSS classes for the component.
propDescs.EvilEye.eyeColor: Primary eye color in HEX format.
propDescs.EvilEye.intensity: Brightness / HDR intensity of the eye color.
propDescs.EvilEye.pupilSize: Size and darkness of the pupil slit.
propDescs.EvilEye.irisWidth: Width of the main iris ring.
propDescs.EvilEye.glowIntensity: Strength of the outer eye glow.
propDescs.EvilEye.scale: Zoom level of the eye. Values > 1 zoom in, < 1 zoom out.
propDescs.EvilEye.noiseScale: Scale of the fire/noise texture sampling.
propDescs.EvilEye.pupilFollow: Intensity of pupil cursor tracking. 0 disables it.
propDescs.FaultyTerminal.scale: Controls the zoom/scale of the pattern.
propDescs.FaultyTerminal.gridMul: Grid multiplier for glyph density [x, y].
propDescs.Ferrofluid.colors: Array of hex colors (up to 8) used to tint the fluid rim. Colors are spread across the surface by height; a single color makes the whole effect uniform.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.speed: Multiplier for how fast the fluid churns and flows.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.scale: Overall feature size. Higher values zoom in for larger, fewer blobs.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.turbulence: Amount of domain distortion. Higher values create more chaotic, swirling motion.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.fluidity: Smoothness of the merge between the two fluid layers. Higher = softer, more liquid blending.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.rimWidth: Thickness of the glowing contour lines tracing the fluid surface.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.sharpness: Contrast of the rim highlights. Higher values give crisper, thinner edges.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.shimmer: Amount of fine grainy break-up applied to the rim. 0 = smooth lines.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.glow: Overall brightness multiplier of the rim highlights.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.flowDirection: Primary direction the fluid surface drifts.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.opacity: Overall alpha of the rendered canvas.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.mouseInteraction: Enables a magnetic spike that rises and glows under the cursor.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.mouseStrength: Intensity of the magnetic cursor spike.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.mouseRadius: Falloff radius of the magnetic cursor spike.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.mouseDampening: Easing time constant (seconds) for the cursor to follow the pointer. 0 = immediate.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.mixBlendMode: If true, stops rendering updates (freezing the current frame).
propDescs.Ferrofluid.dpr: Overrides device pixel ratio; lower for performance, higher for sharpness.
propDescs.Ferrofluid.className: Additional class names for the root container.
propDescs.FloatingLines.linesGradient: Array of hex color strings for gradient coloring of lines (max 8 colors).
propDescs.FloatingLines.enabledWaves: Which wave layers to display. Can toggle individual waves on/off.
propDescs.FloatingLines.lineCount: Number of lines per wave. Single number applies to all waves, or array for per-wave control.
propDescs.FloatingLines.lineDistance: Spacing between lines. Single number applies to all waves, or array for per-wave control.
propDescs.FloatingLines.topWavePosition: Position and rotation settings for the top wave layer.
propDescs.FloatingLines.middleWavePosition: Position and rotation settings for the middle wave layer.
propDescs.FloatingLines.bottomWavePosition: Position and rotation settings for the bottom wave layer.
propDescs.FloatingLines.animationSpeed: Speed multiplier for the wave animation.
propDescs.FloatingLines.interactive: Whether the lines react to mouse/pointer movement.
propDescs.FloatingLines.bendRadius: Radius of the area affected by mouse interaction.
propDescs.FloatingLines.bendStrength: Intensity of the bend effect when interacting with mouse.
propDescs.FloatingLines.mouseDamping: Smoothing factor for mouse movement tracking (0-1).
propDescs.FloatingLines.parallax: Enable parallax effect with mouse movement.
propDescs.FloatingLines.mixBlendMode: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the canvas element.
propDescs.Galaxy.focal: Sets the focal point of the galaxy effect as [x, y] coordinates from 0 to 1
propDescs.Galaxy.rotation: Controls the rotation matrix of the galaxy as [x, y] rotation values
propDescs.Galaxy.starSpeed: Controls the speed of star movement and animation
propDescs.Galaxy.density: Controls the density of stars in the galaxy
propDescs.Galaxy.hueShift: Shifts the hue of all stars by the specified degrees (0-360)
propDescs.Galaxy.disableAnimation: When true, stops all time-based animations
propDescs.Galaxy.speed: Global speed multiplier for all animations
propDescs.Galaxy.mouseInteraction: Enables or disables mouse interaction with the galaxy
propDescs.Galaxy.glowIntensity: Controls the intensity of the star glow effect
propDescs.Galaxy.saturation: Controls color saturation of stars (0 = grayscale, 1 = full color)
propDescs.Galaxy.mouseRepulsion: When true, stars are repelled by the mouse cursor
propDescs.Galaxy.twinkleIntensity: Controls how much stars twinkle (0 = no twinkle, 1 = maximum twinkle)
propDescs.Galaxy.repulsionStrength: Strength of mouse repulsion effect when mouseRepulsion is enabled
propDescs.Galaxy.autoCenterRepulsion: Creates repulsion from center of canvas. Overrides mouse repulsion when > 0
propDescs.Galaxy.transparent: Makes the black background transparent, showing only stars
propDescs.GradientBlinds.gradientColors: Array of hex colors (up to 8) forming the animated gradient. If one color is provided it is duplicated.
propDescs.GradientBlinds.angle: Rotation of the gradient in degrees (0 = horizontal left→right).
propDescs.GradientBlinds.noise: Strength of per-pixel noise added to the final color (0 = clean).
propDescs.GradientBlinds.blindCount: Target number of vertical blinds. Acts as an upper bound when blindMinWidth is set.
propDescs.GradientBlinds.blindMinWidth: Minimum pixel width for each blind. Reduces effective blindCount if necessary to satisfy this width.

propDescs.GradientBlinds.mirrorGradient: Creates a mirrored ping-pong gradient progression instead of a linear wrap.
propDescs.GradientBlinds.spotlightRadius: Normalized spotlight radius relative to the shorter canvas dimension.
propDescs.GradientBlinds.spotlightSoftness: Falloff exponent for spotlight edge. Higher = sharper edge (values >1 increase contrast).
propDescs.GradientBlinds.spotlightOpacity: Overall intensity multiplier for the spotlight highlight.
